Even if you’re just trying to protect yourself, public opinion can be used like a knife against you. 
I left in self defense and for good reason, he made them believe I was the evil one for wanting to leave.
I think this one hurt the most to listen to.
U get used to it...u don't forget!
The pain eventually changes from a boulder to a pebble. But it’s always there. Sometimes in your shoe, sometimes just in fuzzy memories.
How long is “eventually” cause its been more than 2 years
She said “eventually” you forget… and yes you do forget … and it takes time
